Banco Symbols 1: the not-equal sign (U+2260) for the lesson page, normal and bold weight.
Two bars and a slash drawn at the stroke of Atkinson Hyperlegible (regular and bold); built by bin/build-symbols-font on the metrics of KaTeX_Main.
Atkinson Hyperlegible, the lesson font, has no U+2260, and a student's system may have no fallback for it.
KaTeX's license (katex@0.19.0/LICENSE) applies to the font tables (metrics and names) it takes from KaTeX_Main.
